title: Ghost Deck
description: The storyline, expressed as one slide-shaped stub per future slide, BEFORE any layout or Slide IR exists. This is the artifact the Storyline Review checks (reading action_title top-to-bottom must read as one argument) — see references/storyline-review-prompt.md. Once a Ghost Deck passes review, each slide here becomes exactly one Slide IR slide (slide.ghostSlideNumber links them back).

audience.description: Who reads this and in what forum (経営会議/投資委員会/etc.) — per slide-rules.md §0's Define-before-Produce discipline. Never leave implicit.

decisionAsked.description: What the reader should decide or take away after reading. If this can't be stated in one sentence, the deck isn't scoped yet — see the User Brief -> Requirements Normalization step.

role.description: Structural role in the argument, not a visual template — the same role can end up as several different Slide IR templates. Used by the Storyline Review to check the Issue->Analysis->Implication->Recommendation shape and by the Mechanical Gate to decide whether an evidence/source check even applies (cover/section_divider/back_cover never need one).

action_title.description: The slide's conclusion, written as the real slide title will read (slide-rules.md §2: 常体・結論先行・1文). This is the ONLY field the Storyline Review reads in bulk — read every action_title in slide_number order and it must stand alone as a speech.

key_message.description: One sentence: what this slide proves or asserts, and why it matters (the So What). Distinct from action_title — action_title is the headline-as-written; key_message is the underlying point in plain words, used by review to check So-What presence even when the title is compressed.

evidence_needed.description: What facts/figures this slide will need once expanded to Slide IR (e.g. "工程別工数"). Not the figures themselves — Ghost Deck precedes data-gathering. Used to pre-populate slide.claims[] placeholders and to catch 'this slide asserts a number nothing here will supply' before any layout work starts.

transition_from_previous.description: One clause: how this slide's argument follows from the previous slide's. null ONLY for slide_number 1 (and slides immediately after a section_divider/agenda). A non-null value here is what lets the Storyline Review check '各ページが前ページの論理を受けているか' mechanically, not just by re-reading titles.

transition_to_next.description: One clause: what the NEXT slide will do with this one's conclusion. null only for the deck's last content slide before back_cover.
